create.name: Michael Pyrtsch
create.bio:
Michael Pyrtsch is a German meditation teacher and mental trainer from the Mannheim area who trained in sport science, with psychology as a second subject, at Heidelberg University and later qualified as a meditation teacher. His own interest in meditation grew out of a long period of self-inquiry in which close relationships, sustained practice, shadow work and a serious illness abroad all played a part, and he describes his work as helping people recognise and accept the parts of themselves they push away.

Under the name Konzept Null he runs seminars for companies, schools and clubs that combine mental training and guided imagery, meditation and relaxation, physical activation and team exercises, alongside a short grounding in the psychology behind them. He also offers one-to-one coaching and leads online meditation. His guided meditations, in German and English, range from heart-centred and chakra practices to a long Hermetic visualisation, and he records chanting in Sanskrit, Tibetan and ancient Greek. On YouTube and TikTok he adds short talks linking meditation with ideas about time and consciousness drawn from Krishnamurti, David Bohm and modern physics. He has also published a lyrical book in German, Die 33 Tode der Zeit, and a children's book.

courses.title: Konzept Null seminars for companies
courses.description: Workplace seminars of ninety minutes that mix mental training, meditation and relaxation methods, physical activation and team exercises, with a short introduction to the psychology behind them. Taught in German.

courses.title: Konzept Null seminars for schools
courses.description: The same ninety-minute format adapted for pupils, bringing guided imagery, relaxation, movement and group exercises into the classroom. Taught in German.

courses.title: Individual coaching
courses.description: One-to-one sessions of ninety minutes on personal development and self-understanding, drawing on his meditation and mental-training work. A free first conversation can be arranged by email.
courses.price: €60 EUR per session (€30 EUR concession for students, trainees and people on low incomes)

free_resources.title: Michael Pyrtsch on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided meditations in English and German, mantra chanting in several languages and singing-bowl recordings, with occasional live sessions. Free to listen to.

flags: Tier borderline: ~88k total, almost all from TikTok (83.6k, @mentalstaerkung, linked from his site); within the 80k–150k band.
Location unclear: Insight Timer says Karlsruhe, his Insight Timer bio says Mannheim, and his Impressum gives an address in Altrip (Rhineland-Palatinate, next to Mannheim); Mannheim used.
Work is mostly in German (site, seminars, coaching); Insight Timer and YouTube are partly English.
Only one usable photo (headshot on his meditation page); YouTube avatar is a logo and other site images are stock or a certificate.

Books not listed: amazon.com and amazon.de /dp/ pages returned 500/503 on every try. His site links a Kindle ebook 'Die 33 Tode der Zeit' (ASIN B07VP76LKZ, amazon.de) and a children's book (ASIN B0DMWTB6PF via amzn.eu, title not confirmed). A human may want to add them once Amazon loads.
His site's seminar copy makes general claims about meditation's effects on the brain and health; none of that was used.

Much of his YouTube and Insight Timer output is frequency and singing-bowl music with 'healing', 'DNA activation' or 'light body activation' titles, all left out; some kept guided meditations use 'activation' language (chakras, ascension, 'God Seed'), which is spiritual rather than medical but a human may want to check.
Email is a web.de address in the Konzept Null name (his business), published in the site footer and Impressum.
WebFetch would only quote the first sentence of his Insight Timer bio; the bio check ran against that plus his own pages.
